claims.notes: Cross-references CLAIM-048's Phase 6 finding, which independently confirmed Blood Moon's real GM panel exposes '10 town Arenas (index 0-9)' -- an exact match to this video's demonstrated 10 pre-created Arena instances (index 0-9), strong evidence the same underlying Custom Arena architecture is deployed and enabled on Blood Moon. A tracked boss's countdown only starts appearing once a player actually kills it for the first time since the last server restart -- the underlying respawn duration is read from that monster's own existing regen-time column in Monster.txt (converted from seconds), not re-entered separately. This countdown state is NOT persistent: it resets to empty on server restart or a monster/data reload, since nothing has 'died' yet in the new session.

claims.statement: Custom Map Up Level lets an admin set a per-map experience ceiling by Level, Reset count, and/or Master Reset count: once a player's own value meets or exceeds the map's configured cap for any enabled dimension, killing monsters on that map still succeeds (the kill registers, presumably drops still occur) but grants zero experience, and the game shows a message telling the player they cannot exceed the configured limit and must move to a different map to keep progressing. Moving to a different, unrestricted (or differently-capped) map immediately restores normal leveling.

claims.statement: Each of Custom Map Up Level's 3 cap dimensions (Level, Reset, Master Reset) can be independently enabled or disabled per map -- a value of -1 in a given field means 'no requirement' for that specific dimension, so a map's restriction can be based on Level alone, Reset alone, Master Reset alone, or any combination, by leaving the unwanted dimensions at -1.
claims.notes: Consistent with the same -1-disables-check convention already confirmed for the ResetMin/ResetMax event-entry gate in CLAIM-035 -- appears to be a shared, engine-wide config convention across multiple unrelated vendor features, not specific to this one system.

claims.statement: Custom Map Pk lets an admin list specific maps where simply entering the map auto-flags the character as PK (killer status), regardless of actual kill history -- the normal /pk-clear command is explicitly blocked from working while standing on one of these listed maps. Hardcoded engine behavior (auto-PK-on-entry, blocked pk-clear command) not visible in a static config read.
